text:
maria (PM): Ok team, this thread is to lock the tenant rollout safety layers and signoff criteria for model-v2. We need a practical checklist that works for hosted, dedicated, and private.

sam (eng): Agreed. I'd like to keep feature flags per-tenant + a global master. For Dedicated we can flip at pool-level. For Private, toggles must be local-only unless customer allows remote control.

lee (sre): Safety layers I care about: p95 latency delta, 5xx rate, KV cache warm-up, token backlog. Each has a threshold + duration window to trigger auto-fallback. Suggest: p95 delta > 20% for 10m OR 5xx > 1% for 5m => fallback.

anjali (cs): Customer-facing asks: beta tenants need SLA/rollback guarantees and a named on-call. We should prepare a one-pager for invited tenants describing the rollback policy and what support they get.

david (security): For private deployments, toggles must be change-signed (KMS) and logged locally. No remote toggle without a signed, timestamped request. Add an audit-log retention entry to the checklist (SOC2 requirement).

olivia (prod-ops): I can deliver: API for toggles, console with per-tenant toggle + change history, and an audit export. Proposal for flag schema (keeps it minimal):
```yaml
flag_name: model_v2_enabled
scope: [global, tenant, pool]
strategy: [percent, explicit_list, staged]
stages:
  - id: stage-1
    desc: us-canary
    pct: 3
    region: us
```
I'll wire the console to show active stage + last 10 changes.

sam (eng): Add: shadow traffic runner for 48h. We'll run shadowing with sampling=10% for internal traffic and 1% for prod traffic to collect quality signals before flipping. Also add an A/B eval job comparing model-v2 vs model-v1 on a curated prompt set.

lee (sre): Operational tests before canary: fallback rehearsals (manual and auto), SLA spike simulation, and cache-warmup pacing. We should also rehearse a cross-region failover during the canary window.

qa-bot: smoke-suite results: tier-1 smoke passed on staging (all checks green).

sam (eng): I'll post the infra PR for toggles + shadow runner. Need an infra signoff for Dedicated kernel fallback paths (quantized vs non-quantized).

maria (PM): Signoff criteria (draft) that we can agree on now:
- Shadowing: 48h of shadow traffic with no quality regressions on the smoke eval set.
- Latency: p95 delta <= 15% vs model-v1 for US canary; no region > 20%
- Errors: 5xx < 0.5% during canary window
- Auto-fallback: validated in staging (manual + auto triggers)
- Audit: toggle audit logs enabled for Private + Dedicated; KMS-signed toggle requirement present for Private
- Customer comms: invited tenants have SLA one-pager + named on-call
- Rollback test: simulated rollback executed end-to-end

anjali (cs): Add customer opt-in list and comms timeline to the doc. We should give tenants 48h notice before opt-in and provide opt-out within the first 2 hours after their traffic is included.

david (security): Also add a crypto timestamp on toggle requests and a replay-protection nonce. For Private, require local verification of signature before applying toggle.

lee (sre): Thresholds to codify for automation:
- p95_delta_pct > 20% sustained for 10m -> auto-fallback
- 5xx_rate > 1% for 5m -> auto-fallback
- token_queue_depth > X for 5m -> throttle + alert
We should expose these as config knobs per-tenant.

sam (eng): A/B experiment: run quality evals with automated metrics (BLEU-like, semantic sim, and human-ish classifier) and define an accept/reject rule. If quality score drop > delta for top-k prompts -> rollback. We'll keep the exact prompt list in a repo.

olivia (prod-ops): UI note: surface the current rollout stage, percent, last change author, and one-click rollback. For Private, UI should render but grayed out unless signed toggle detected.

maria (PM): Owners + next actions:
- Olivia: draft console + API + audit export (ETA Tue)
- Sam: infra toggles + shadow runner + A/B eval job (ETA Tue)
- Lee: SRE runbook + automated thresholds + rehearsal plan (ETA Mon)
- Anjali: customer invite list + SLA one-pager + comms timeline (ETA Tue)
- David: security checklist for Private toggles (ETA Tue)

maria (PM): Once owners have deliverables, we'll run a 2-hour rollout rehearsal with sales/CS included. Final signoff after rehearsal. Wed 11am proposed for rehearsal.

deploy-bot: canary-config branch deployed to staging for rehearsals (sha: def456) — starting smoke and shadow hooks.

sam (eng): I'll monitor shadow logs and post a short report in this thread when we have 12h of data.

maria (PM): Thanks all. If anyone has objections to the criteria above, flag them now. Otherwise consider this the source of truth for the rollout plan until changed. :thumbsup:
